Aries, your fiery Mars is screaming caution right now before the weekend cosmic storm truly breaks apart this week.

Early week, Venus in your career House squares your ruling planet in Leo, spurring intense professional rivalry. But Tuesday’s Mercury sextile smooths the careful talks today.

Mid-week, Mercury enters Scorpio and flips the script inside your critical eighth House of shared resources and values.

By Friday, that transit turns your reputation truly into gold. A Venus opposition ignites a deep, lasting soulmate romance that defies all your current logic.

Thursday is your power day because Venus shines directly in your tenth House of wealth and prosperous career power. Wednesday is your risk day because Mercury opposes your natal Sun, hiding hidden serious costs you cannot afford.

Channel your inner fire into one bold move, not three scattered, desperate ones this very day.

Follow for cosmic daily updates.
